## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a specific emergency navigation challenge or algorithmic limitation?
(e.g. "Currently, turn restrictions cannot be modeled on node-based graphs...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it fits into the project architecture.
- Which layer does this affect? (Data layer / Graph layer / Routing Engine / Evaluation)
- How does it preserve our **zero external runtime dependencies** principle?

## Alternative Approaches Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, algorithms, or approaches you have evaluated.

## Verification & Testing Plan
How will this feature be tested?
- Unit test strategy:
- Expected branch coverage impact:
- Benchmark or demonstration script:

## Alignment with Roadmap
Does this proposal correspond to an existing phase in [`docs/roadmap.md`](docs/roadmap.md)?
